title: Stop Doing This At Traffic Lights
hook: Stop turning your wheels too early.

script.narration: Stop turning your wheels too early while waiting to make a left at a green light.
script.visual_search: car waiting at intersection interior view

script.narration: If someone rear-ends you, your pointed wheels push you straight into oncoming traffic. Keep them pointed straight until you actually start moving.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because you should...

description:
Learn a crucial safety habit for waiting at intersections. Keeping your wheels straight prevents devastating secondary collisions if you get hit from behind.

Subscribe to Learn in 60 Seconds for fast, essential driving tips every day.
